name: Minestrike
storyline: The gameplay takes place in the format of a multi—round match between two teams of players, one of whom plays the role of "terrorists" and the other of counter-terrorism special forces; before the start of each match, players select a "map" on which the battle will take place. A team can achieve victory in a round by simply killing all opponents or by completing certain tasks that may differ for different maps. At the beginning of each round, players can buy weapons and auxiliary equipment with in-game currency; at the end of each round, players receive a certain amount of virtual money, which they can use to purchase more powerful and effective weapons in the next round!
summary: Minestrike - is a multiplayer first-person shooter computer game that combines fast-paced competitive gameplay, a unique atmosphere, and exciting team battles.
